Prediction and intervention

The intact heatmap stays fixed when switching replacements. Ablation replaces the selected head’s attention-weighted value vector at every position, before the output projection; it does not erase attention edges. Loss is scored on the actual next token.

What this does and does not establish

These are causal effects of specified replacements on this model and these inputs. Attention weights alone do not include the value vectors or downstream computation. A large effect does not identify a complete head function, and a small effect does not prove irrelevance. Zero and mean replacements can create atypical hidden states; disagreement between them is substantive evidence about intervention sensitivity.

Calibration uses 1,024 input positions from Alice’s Adventures in Wonderland; evaluation uses 1,024 predictions from The Adventures of Sherlock Holmes. Each split has 16 non-overlapping 65-token blocks: 64 inputs plus the final target. Context resets between blocks, with no added BOS token. Means pool all calibration positions and remain fixed. This small pretrained checkpoint may have seen both books during training. The texts are separate here, not demonstrated unseen training data. No general language-model, task-generalization or statistical-significance claim follows.

Only the first two evaluation blocks have saved attention visualizations, chosen before measurement. Aggregate loss covers all 16 blocks. Displayed attention is rounded to six decimals; the NPZ preserves float32 values. Float32 CPU eager attention, dropout disabled, two threads, no KV cache. No-op uses the same cloning/reassignment path and must exactly preserve every token loss for every head.

Reproduce and inspect

Open this HTML directly; it needs no server or network. From the repository root, after the documented dependency setup:

.venv/bin/python -m attention_lab.pretrained fetch
.venv/bin/python -m attention_lab.pretrained run --output /tmp/attention-pretrained-replay
.venv/bin/python scripts/verify_pretrained.py --replay /tmp/attention-pretrained-replay

The first command downloads and verifies the pinned public model once. The second runs fully offline. Model weights are cached outside the tracked tree. Exact inputs, excerpts, source hashes and protocol are in experiments/pretrained; per-token losses, calibration means, full-precision attention and provenance accompany this report.
